rows.en: There's still more of them!?
One after another!
There's still more of them!?
At this rate, there's no end to it!
More enemies?
Just how many of them are there!?
...Wait, there's still more of them!?
Being hard-boiled sure is tough.
Still this many!?
At this rate, there's no end to it.
Whoa, so there's still more of you punks!
I'm at my climax all the way!!
What is it this time!?
Just how many of these damn things are there!?
Why, you...!
Th-they're good!
Ugh...
Ngh! They're stronger than the last ones!!
Whoa!!
Whoa!! What the hell are you doing!!
Tch!! Outta nowhere, huh!!
Reinforcements, now!?
This is bad... What do we do!?
Reinforcements!?
This is bad... What do we do!?
More of them showed up!?
Not here... not like this...!!
Reinforcements!?
Even for us, these odds are bad...!!
More enemies!?
Wh-what should we do...!?
Wha-!!? Just how many of them are gonna show up!?
Now this is... seriously bad!!
Crap!! When did they get there!!
Damn it!! What do we do!?
Just then!!
I'm aiming and firing!!
Target confirmed! Mission accepted!
Outta the way~!! The God of Death is comin' through!!
00, eliminating the target!
Tch! What a nuisance, butting in like this.
Grrr!! You guys again!!
Celestial Being's Gundams, every last one of you!!
It can't be helped. We'll withdraw for today.
See ya later~!!
Hey! Get back here, damn it!!
...Tch! Those guys sure are quick to run.
You guys okay?
That black mobile doll, the Taurus, is a tough enemy. As a mobile doll, it's the finished article.
Still, the way you drove off those Leos was impressive, y'know?
Sorry, you saved us. I'm grateful.
Thank you. That was close.
Thank you very much. You all saved us.
Sorry for putting you to the trouble. I'm grateful.
Thank you. If things had kept going like that, we'd have been in trouble.
My bad! Havin' you guys bail us out like that.
If things kept goin' like that, we'd have been in real trouble. Thanks a bunch!
Come on, you don't need to thank us.
You guys don't seem to be enemies of Celestial Being, after all.
I see. By the way, who are you...
I see. By the way, who are you all...
I see. By the way, who might you all be...
I see. By the way, just who are you guys...
I see. By the way, who... are you all?
Right! By the way, just who the hell are you guys?
I see. By the way, who are you?
Whoops, we haven't introduced ourselves yet!
The name's Cherudim Gundam. I'm Celestial Being's sniper.
I'm Gundam Deathscythe Hell. Nice to meet ya!
Nice to meet ya!
All right, now tell us about yourselves.
Wait, I'm sure there were two more of you...
Huh? There were two more of you, weren't there?

notes.note: Leader-variant blocks (#0.62-75 in pairs, #0.80-86, #0.93-106 in pairs, #0.135-141, #0.151-157, #0.163-164) follow a 7-slot order; slot 4 is W (hard-boiled/Philip lines), slot 6 is Momotaros (climax, rough speech), slot 7 is a rough brash voice (Zero-like). Speaker labels are partial/shifted, so voices were taken from content.

Labelled W (Philip) along with #0.94 and #0.100, but by slot order #0.93/94 is slot 1 and #0.99 (labelled Zero) + #0.100 form the W pair (Shotaro asks, Philip assesses). Translated neutrally from content.
Literal sense: 'even so, this situation is unfavourable'. Rendered 'Even for us, these odds are bad' to keep the 'sasuga ni' nuance.
Bare exclamation 'this enemy...!' rendered as the natural English outburst 'Why, you...!'.
'Yaru' = the foe is skilled; subject restored as 'they' (the Tauruses).
Literal 'In a place like this...!!'; rendered as 'Not here... not like this...!!' (frustration at being cornered). Kept trailing.
Lockon's catchphrase (nerai-utsu ze) rendered 'I'm aiming and firing!!'.
Setsuna's 'X, eliminating the target' formula kept with '00'.
No speaker recovered; context (Duo's next line #0.130) suggests Deathscythe Hell shouting after the fleeing Trinity. Rough 'kora' kept as 'damn it'.
Leo (Gundam Wing mobile doll) not in glossary; kept 'Leos' as story_021 did.
Momotaros-style apology 'warii na' rendered 'My bad!'; subject 'you guys' restored for the rescuers.
Unlabelled lone 'yoroshiku na!' right after Duo's self-intro; likely a duplicate/branch of Duo's line or a party reply. Translated plainly as 'Nice to meet ya!'.
Zero/slot-1 notices 00 and Wing Zero (who appeared in #0.111/#0.117) haven't introduced themselves; 'two more of you' refers to them (confirmed by story_023 #0.172-177).

report: 80/80 rows translated. Leader-variant labels are partial/shifted (#0.93/94/100 Philip, #0.99 Zero); voices taken from slot content. #0.129 speaker inferred as Deathscythe Hell; #0.161 unlabelled lone 'Nice to meet ya!' of unclear speaker. Name not in glossary: Leo (as in story_021).
